name: research-progress
description: Daily lightweight research progress report demo.
goal: Collect latest research progress and generate a short report. This v0.1 demo uses a static report payload until research-fetcher is implemented.

input.title: Research Progress Brief
input.description: Scheduled research progress demo generated by Cyborg-Agent.

props.title: Research Progress Brief
props.subtitle: A tiny model should be able to run this task because the workflow is code and config, not a huge prompt.

items.title: Recurring
items.body: The workflow repeats every day and should live as config and code.

items.title: Cheap
items.body: The small model only needs compact tool metadata and a short task goal.
